rationale: unit:shared.steps matches Configuration, initial, finished, State.bind/create, Capture, Step, Steps and Stuck. Every Step constructor demands destination absence in the original variables, consumes exactly the head statement and retains rest. give stores Give's result; giveShare binds a shared reference to the same result target. Capture recursively processes argument variables in order: unique clears that occurrence before continuing, shared preserves it, and nil accepts no operands. The arity equality plus zip gives one initialized field per declaration in order. State.create adds the object at nextId, binds its unique owner and advances the counter; empty fields and arguments are admitted. Under the stated distinct-variable convention this permits repeated shared operands and excludes a repeated consumed unique operand. Capture is a premise of one Step, so its intermediate lists are not execution configurations. Steps includes reflexivity and successful composition, and Stuck is precisely nonfinished plus absence of any successor. These are operational claims, without an unstated progress or recovery guarantee.
